title: Bandhan Bank to issue 1 lakh credit cards by FY27 end: CEO Partha Pratim Sengupta
summary: Bandhan Bank is targeting around 1 lakh credit card issuances by the end of FY27, MD & CEO Partha Pratim Sengupta told ETBFSI and that the two month old card business has already issued 34,000 cards. The bank is positioning credit cards as a key part of its corporate salary account and customer acquisition strategy.
